name: Alex Service Hello
description: Demonstrates a service-mode backend: a long-running node:http server bound to a host-allocated loopback port. The host injects ALEX_SERVICE_PORT and ALEX_RUNTIME_TOKEN and waits for the backend to report `alex.ready` on stderr before marking the runtime Ready. Stage-3 slices will add an `alex://app/api/*` reverse proxy so the frontend can talk to this server.
